FINDING tests/test_a_cold_read_walks_the_docs_tree_once.py:184 follow-on: max(cold["reads"].values(), default=0) <= 1 is vacuously true when the measured counter is empty, and the run's only positive control (probe_control, asserted at :172 and :174) is captured before the counters are cleared in the driver at lines 63-65, so no assertion requires the measured window to have observed a read and a regression that stops reading documents entirely would leave this bound true and the goal unmeasured in the direction that matters.
FINDING reckon/metadata_index.py:472 follow-on: the durability instrument counts only Path.read_text, while the same documents are read through path.read_bytes() in _content_digest (called at :161, :377, :824 and :894), so a repeated byte-level read of a covered file during the covered-file check or index revalidation is invisible to the max(...) <= 1 bound and the claim reads each file at most once is bounded by one accessor rather than by the file.
